_doc: KERNEL-1 / SMALL-CHANGE-1: the canonical, server-side record of the specification work that is built but not all merged, so that no session ending loses it. Each entry lists a marker file that exists on main when the entry has landed; python3 -m foundation shipplan --status reads it, --next names what to do, --check fails until every entry has landed. The unmerged code lives in the private ultrastable/ops repository under wip/ (PR 47); nothing here is deployed.

slices.title: Module migrations and the generated bundle
Kernel exports, trust, deploy digest, export, predict and the destructive-migration exporter
Staff review and research, lifecycle monitoring and closing, plus loop, governance scan
Consent links, graph, discovery, pacing, progress, stickiness, migration self-apply
Seed fixes and the first seed specification tests
Second group of seed specification tests
Last seed specification tests and first foundation specification tests
Conformance manifest, conformance tooling and docs (last: the manifest needs every test merged)

remaining.what: The resumed specification run's output (clusters C to K, the 8 new specifications' requirements, fixes, integration) is verified, sliced and shipped; the specifications go to the private repository
The unfinished Cloudflare adapter entry (worker.js and its tests) is finished and shipped
Foundation tests that read the private specification text skip or run in registry mode when it is absent
